notice: Small hand-labeled synthetic sanity benchmark; not evidence of accuracy on real student resumes.

local_llm_comparison.reason: Optional local model experiment must be run separately with installed model weights. No LLM result is inferred from fallback output.

retrieval.definition: Groundedness measures exact excerpt inclusion, not semantic correctness of an LLM or source authenticity.

vector_hybrid_comparison.reason: Requires cached Sentence Transformers weights and a running Qdrant service; keyword scores are not vector scores.

roadmap_comparison.definition: Exact required-skill overlap of unfinished tasks in one synthetic scenario, not measured learning improvement or a placement outcome.

csv_import_reliability.notice: Includes activation, resume and drive steps; not isolated import throughput.

tenant_isolation.notice: Negative API/adapter cases; not an independent penetration test.
